fusions.name: Marginalia
fusions.desc: Flicks an annotated slip into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It deals 15% more damage for each affliction on the target, up to 60% more.

fusions.name: Struck Through
fusions.desc: Strikes the target, dealing 18 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Recite From Memory
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Well-Thumbed Manual
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner.
